_comment: Allowlist for scripts/check_test_weakening.py (Layer 4, #52). Replaced the ALLOW_TEST_WEAKEN=1 environment override on 2026-08-08 — that was a blanket, invisible, whole-run bypass that silenced every file at once, left no trace in the reviewed diff, and was wired to a PR label in both CI workflows so it could be set from outside the repo. Each entry sanctions ONE file's deletion with an EXACT delta and a written reason. Governance mirrors .health-endpoint-allowlist.json / .urllib-httperror-close-allowlist.json: rationale >= 40 chars, malformed entries hard-fail. Two rules are specific to this guard: (1) an entry grants exactly its recorded allowed_delta — a measured delta WORSE than the entry fails, so an entry can never absorb future weakening of the same file; (2) a file with no entry fails as before. DO NOT widen an allowed_delta to make a new failure go away: that converts a one-time sanction into a permanent licence for the file, which is the hole this mechanism replaced.
_stale_policy: A STALE entry (file absent from the branch diff, or measured delta better than recorded) is a WARNING printed on every run, NOT a hard error — deliberately unlike the sibling allowlists, whose input is the filesystem. This guard diffs against merge-base(origin/master, HEAD), which MOVES: the moment a branch carrying an entry merges, its file leaves the diff and the entry goes stale through nobody's fault, and hard-failing would turn master red for everyone. Both entries below are expected to go stale once the ADR-0215 train merges — delete them then.

yadgar/tests/e2e/test_scope_filter_e2e.p.rationale: Deleted by Car 1 (7bf28dda) of the ADR-0215 branch-scoping-removal train. Every assertion in it covered branch+directory scope COMPOSITION, and ADR-0215 removes the branch axis entirely (column, hints, §25 resolution), so the asserted behaviour no longer exists to test. The directory half of the coverage is restored in yadgar/tests/e2e/test_scope_filter_directory_only_e2e.py, which is +14 on the same branch — but the guard nets PER FILE, deliberately, so that replacement cannot silently offset this deletion and the sanction has to be written down here.

yadgar/tests/scripts/test_v5_42_2_branch.rationale: Deleted by edff7625 under ADR-0215. The file existed solely to reproduce the v5.42.2 branch-default scope mismatch (the drainer wrote branch='master' while wiki_check_duplicate filtered scope={None}); with the branch axis gone there is no branch default, no scope set and no mismatch that can occur, so the reproduction is unreproducible by construction. 4 of its 8 assertions were relocated verbatim into test_v5_42_1_gate_verification_e2e.py, where they still cover the similarity gate's full retrieval path (drainer commit -> embedding -> HNSW -> KNN); the other 4 asserted the branch behaviour itself and are gone with it.
